comment: Every transcript quoted in an example README must be what the simulator actually prints. This is the gate that stops documentation drifting away from code: ch23/ch24/ch26 had stale file:line references and a missing test for months because nothing checked, and the drift was only found on 2026-08-04 when the check was written. Runs all 22 chapter sims plus tinyalu_tb and compares line by line, then sweeps every book-pdf/src chapter and the repository README for transcript lines of their own. Skips without iverilog.
